wiki.title: Scott Surovell
wiki.extract: Scott Anthony Surovell (born August 21, 1971) is an American lawyer and politician representing Virginia's 34th Senate district, which encompasses the city of Fairfax and portions of Fairfax County. A member of the Democratic Party, he has served as the majority leader of the Virginia Senate since 2024, succeeding Dick Saslaw, who had been the Democratic leader in the Virginia Senate since 1998.
